summary: Reliance Global Group filed an 8-K disclosing entry into several definitive agreements to form LifeSci Global Group LLC (LGG) and for LGG to invest in Innervate Radiopharmaceuticals LLC. The company holds 51% of LGG; the remaining 49% is held by management including the CEO and a board member. LGG subscribed for up to 421,053 Class A units of Innervate at $4.75/unit ($2M aggregate). A $2M promissory note from a Reliance subsidiary funds the investment at 7% interest, due in 2031. This is a strategic investment/venture formation, not a transformative special situation—board approved. Watch for Innervate's milestone progress.
